newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat says peace process with Israel in crisis.
newsitem.headline: Arafat says peace process with Israel in crisis.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat said on Monday Israeli-PLO peace efforts were in real crisis and accused Israel of breaching its peace commitments.
"There is a real crisis because there is a clear breaching to what had been agreed upon," Arafat told reporters in Gaza.
Arafat made the remark after his aide said on Monday that chief Palestinian negotiator with Israel Mahmoud Abbas had tendered his resignation over what he called the Jewish state's intransigence.
Arafat declined to answer questions on the reported resignation. Abbas, also known as Abu Mazen, was not immediately available to comment.

Israel angered Palestinians last week with its decision to hand over only nine percent of the West Bank in the first of three withdrawals outlined in a 1995 peace agreement. Palestinians say they were expecting 30 percent of the land.
Arafat said the Israeli decision was "a trick and a conspiracy against the peace process".
